definitions.explanation: An animal that hunts and eats other animals for food.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライオン→ライオン：05197_raion⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{草原|そうげん}→草原：05035_sougen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捕食者|ほしょくしゃ}だ。
examples.english: Lions are predators of the savanna.

examples.japanese: {捕食者|ほしょくしゃ}がいない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧。
examples.english: The ecosystem becomes unbalanced without predators.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天敵|てんてき}→天敵：15846_tenteki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧{捕食者|ほしょくしゃ}がいない⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れない→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧。
examples.english: Because there are no predators as natural enemies on this island, the birds are not afraid of humans.

notes:
{捕食者|ほしょくしゃ} is a scientific/technical term for an animal that hunts others for food. It is commonly used in ecology, biology education, and nature documentaries.

FORMS:
⟦{捕食|ほしょく}→捕食：12819_hoshoku⟧ (predation, catching and eating) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (one who ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{頂点|ちょうてん}→頂点：05448_chouten⟧{捕食者|ほしょくしゃ}: apex predator
- {捕食者|ほしょくしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{被|ひ}{捕食者|ほしょくしゃ}: predator and prey
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捕食者|ほしょくしゃ}: natural predator

RELATED WORDS:
- {被|ひ}{捕食者|ほしょくしゃ}: prey (technical)
- ⟦{天敵|てんてき}→天敵：15846_tenteki⟧: natural enemy (more common in everyday use)
- ⟦{食物連鎖|しょくもつれんさ}→食物連鎖：08437_shokumotsurensa⟧: food chain
- ⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧: ecosystem

REGISTER:
In casual speech, ⟦{天敵|てんてき}→天敵：15846_tenteki⟧ is more commonly used. {捕食者|ほしょくしゃ} sounds academic or documentary-like.
